programs.title: The Pulse of Modernization
programs.desc: Following real people, this documentary showcases contemporary developments in China’s ongoing economic exploration. From low-altitude aircraft to smart farms, robots to open-source models, this documentary shows pioneers determined to embrace change and innovation in action. Where else could you find such a vivid picture of China-style modernization.

programs.title: Lancang-Mekong: The River That Flows South Ep.3
programs.desc: This documentary follows 24 families along the Lancang-Mekong River—their lives, their connections, and the quiet ways they remain independent yet bound to one another. What emerges is a portrait of shared wisdom, shaped by the river and passed down for generations.

programs.title: The Call of Glaciers
programs.desc: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is one of the world's most climate-sensitive regions. As its indigenous peoples, animals, and plants face the impacts of climate change, a Gen Z environmentalist rediscovers her homeland, with plenty of new insight along the way.

programs.title: Modern Agriculture in China Ep.4
programs.desc: This story looks at how Chinese agricultural machinery has become a pillar of national strength, helping to secure the country's food supply while becoming an international model for developing countries.

programs.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programs.desc: Huangshan Mountain in eastern China’s Anhui Province should be on every tea-lover’s bucket list, and hosts Tianran and Hannah are here to tell us why. This time they’re immersing themselves in Huizhou culture, a region with plenty of its own specialties, like character-shaped candy, hairy tofu, and even stinky mandarin fish. But don’t let the name fool you—this one’s a real treat.

programs.title: Human Carbon Footprint
programs.desc: How exactly does China drive green development and harmony with nature? Examples like smart mining at Heidaigou Opencast Coal Mine, cleaner fossil fuel use, and a thermal plant working alongside renewables offer part of the answer.
